Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing for the contracting out of the management of state trust lands.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contracting out the management of state trustlands; adding a new section to chapter 79.02 RCW; creating a newsection; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department is authorized to contract out the management of allstate trust lands. Land managed on a contract basis is subject to allrelevant state and federal forest laws.

(1) The office of financial management andthe department of personnel must develop procedures and standards toallow the department of natural resources to contract out themanagement of state trust lands. (2) The office of financial management and the department ofpersonnel must jointly submit a report to the legislature that containsdetailed proposed legislation that will allow the department of naturalresources to contract out the management of state trust lands. Thereport to the legislature is due by January 1, 2006. p. 1 SB 5816 (3) The department of natural resources is required to fullycooperate with the office of financial management and the department ofpersonnel in implementing the report required in subsection (2) of thissection and in any other aspects of creating a contracting out program.
Section 1 of this act takes effect July 1,2006.

Section 2 of this act is necessary for theimmediate preservation of the public peace, health, or safety, orsupport of the state government and its existing public institutions,and takes effect immediately.
